notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-11-11. Spans are sliced verbatim from data/processed/articles.jsonl by scripts/draft_test_gold_graphs.py and each edge passes the B6 rule layer. Two annotators then labelled every drafted edge independently, blind to the draft and to each other: raw agreement 1.000 on whether the span asserts the relation (Cohen's kappa 1.000) and 1.000 on direction, with kappa undefined there because one label was used throughout. Strength agreed on 1 of 8 (raw 0.125, kappa 0.000), and the pre-declared direct-versus-hedged collapse did not rescue it because that is the axis of the split (reports/adjudication_kappa_test.md). Reconciliation applied one rule, D-30: strength is read off the modality of the clause carrying the causal claim, not off the manner in which the mechanism is described, so a claim under 'would' is conditional however firmly the mechanism inside it is worded. Both annotators independently rejected the same two FPI_FLOWS -> GSEC_10Y edges, which are dropped, leaving four edges per graph at exactly MIN_EDGES. The reviewers' attestation lives in data/eval/gold/test/review_receipt.json and is signed separately. Two of the four test queries carry no graph at all: test-cpi-why by D-27, and test-cpi-effects by D-27a.
